question: Which among the following was the first state in the country to fix floor prices of vegetables, with effect from 1 November 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kerala became the first state to fix the floor price for vegetables, which would be 20 percent above the production cost.**
 
• The scheme would come into effect from **November 1, 2020.**
 
• This was the first time the floor price was fixed for 16 varieties of vegetables produced in Kerala.</strong&
